name: Review a property-tax postcard proof
goal: Render a private local postcard proof for the selected owner and parcel. External mailing remains a separately approved owner action.

config.prompt: Your step: Review the exact local proof files in $GLACIER_HOME/ventures/property-tax/postcards, the source record, recipient address, sender, and do-not-mail status. This approves review only. Glacier does not send postcards in this flow.

config.template:
The local postcard proof was reviewed. No postcard was mailed. Any future external mailing needs a separate approval that shows the exact recipients, design, sender, and approved spend.

{summary}

The local postcard proof was not approved. No postcard was mailed.

{summary}

Postcard proof rendering failed. Check sender identity, address fields, and suppression status. No postcard was mailed.

{summary}

acceptance.cmd: repo="${GLACIER_REPO:-$HOME/w/glacier-lean}"; if [ ! -f "$repo/ventures/property-tax/scripts/property_tax.py" ]; then repo="$(find "$HOME/w/workers" -maxdepth 5 -path '*/ventures/property-tax/scripts/property_tax.py' -print -quit)"; fi; test -n "$repo" && cd "$repo" && "${GLACIER_PYTHON:-$HOME/w/glacier-lean/.venv/bin/python}" -c "import json,os,pathlib; d=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures'/'property-tax'/'postcards'; assert d.exists()"
